cand.title: UALE 2027 Conference
cand.excerpt: Confirmed dates and venue establish the event; commercial accessibility and room demand remain to be verified.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Two relevant named leadership routes: Zach Cunningham, Vice President – Higher Education, and Richard Gaboton, Vice President – Unions, both listed on the 2025–2027 board. Archived UALE bylaws assign the Vice Presidents responsibility for chairing the Conference Planning Committee and planning/convening the biennial conference. This makes them sensible referral/oversight contacts, not verified 2027 hotel-contract signatories. Elizabeth Pellerito is the current President and a secondary escalation route. No named 2027 housing manager or external PCO was identified. The current event’s public inquiry route is ualeconference2027@gmail.com; the page also retains the prior 2025 address in parentheses.
findings.futureEdition: Officially announced upcoming edition: June 1–4, 2027, Toronto, Ontario, at “University of Toronto Conference Center.” These are activity dates, not publication dates, and fall within the requested horizon. The announcement explicitly says “New date and location!” Proposals open November 4, 2026, close January 22, 2027, with acceptance planned for mid-February. No later edition was established by the reviewed sources.
findings.hotelProductFit: Conditional sales thesis, not a demand forecast: using the supplied 157-room Harbourfront hotel profile, pursue a limited delegate/speaker/executive lodging allocation rather than conference relocation or exclusive housing. The event’s announced downtown Chestnut Street venue makes a city hotel more relevant than a resort, but Radisson’s waterfront location is not co-located with the venue. The university advertises hotels across the street or a short walk away and summer residence accommodation in the venue building; proximity and price may limit capture. Event size is unpublished, so neither whole-event fit nor excessive scale can be concluded. The supplied 15–109 peak-room range is a hotel targeting constraint, not UALE demand. Do not sell catered receptions until the hotel confirms current restaurant/lounge and catering capability.
findings.venueCommitments: Organizer-published venue commitment: “will be held at the University of Toronto Conference Center from June 1-4, 2027.” The university identifies its Conference Centre at 89 Chestnut St, Toronto, ON M5G 1R1, in downtown Toronto proper. Matching the organizer’s venue wording to that street address is a strong identification inference: UALE does not itself print the address. This is downtown/Chestnut Street, not Harbourfront, MTCC or Exhibition Place. The venue is not a competing hotel; its building also contains Chestnut Residence. Public announcement does not prove a signed contract or disclose contracted rooms/spaces.
findings.historicalRotation: Documented sequence: 2019 Philadelphia; 2021 virtual after the planned Chicago edition moved online; 2023 Lowell; 2025 Los Angeles; 2027 Toronto. UALE expressly adopted a biennial conference schedule in 2019, so recurrence is verified rather than inferred annually. Destination changes are evidenced, but no fixed rotation, guaranteed Toronto return or subsequent destination is established.
findings.accommodationSourcing: 2027 hotel sourcing is unconfirmed. The official 2027 page publishes no hotel names, booking link, room-block inventory, housing bureau or open hotel RFP; it is a call for proposals. Its relevant venue wording is “will be held at the University of Toronto Conference Center,” which confirms meeting location, not housing. By contrast, the historical 2025 page explicitly says “UALE has reserved a block of rooms” at the Biltmore Hotel in Los Angeles. The university’s generic nearby-amenities page says “Here are a few hotel options that are close to The Conference Centre” and lists DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel Toronto Downtown; Sheraton Centre Toronto Hotel; Hilton Toronto; Chelsea Hotel Toronto; Holiday Inn Toronto Downtown Centre; and The Marriott Eaton Centre. It also advertises summer accommodation at Chestnut, Knox and Oak House residences. None is an edition-specific UALE 2027 commitment. No published attendance, peak-room or room-night figure was located; no numeric demand estimate is defensible from these sources.
findings.organizationStructure: UALE is an association of labor educators, not a scaling company or a venue/agency. It owns the conference programme; elected officers and its Executive Board govern the association. The university Conference Centre is the announced meeting venue, not established as the lodging buyer. No external PCO, DMC or housing bureau is named in the current announcement. The UCLA Labor Center/IRLE hosted 2025; that historical role must not be assigned to Toronto 2027.
findings.competitiveLimitations: No verified UALE 2027 incumbent hotel, contracted housing bureau, sellout, waitlist or overflow requirement was found. Nearby hotel and summer residence options create plausible competition, not proven commitments or displacement. Historical Biltmore lodging belongs to Los Angeles 2025 only. The university advertises group/extended-stay accommodation rates and Chestnut rooms with breakfast; whether UALE uses those options is unknown. Hotel union-status requirements also remain unconfirmed; an older UALE Chicago logistics page specifically highlighted a union hotel, which is a question to qualify rather than a current eligibility rule.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact ualeconference2027@gmail.com now, requesting referral to the housing lead and copying/asking for Zach Cunningham and Richard Gaboton through UALE’s leadership channels. Ask: is 89 Chestnut the intended building; are hotels or residences already contracted; who can approve a supplementary block; what are expected out-of-town attendance, arrival/departure pattern, peak rooms, room nights, budget, accessibility and union-property requirements? Only after a positive response, offer a modest non-exclusive lodging proposal within actual available inventory, without a promised room count or catered function. Recheck housing after planned programme acceptances in mid-February 2027. Treat this as qualification, not an RFP response.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: The June 2027 event is confirmed and its meeting venue is announced. Access to lodging business is unconfirmed, not open by default and not known to be committed elsewhere. The conference inquiry inbox provides a route to ask who handles accommodation and whether supplemental hotel proposals are welcome. No evidence supports offering overflow as an existing need.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: For the announced Toronto edition, seek permission to compete for supplemental lodging only if organizers confirm unmet needs. Longer-term association relationship development is supported by the verified biennial series, but no later Toronto edition/date or open venue competition is established. Do not roll 2027 dates forward or treat recurring conferences in other cities as Toronto hotel demand.

supportingSources.claim: Actual June 1–4, 2027 activity dates, Toronto and announced university venue; current conference inquiry inbox.
Archived bylaws assign conference planning to Vice Presidents; present purchasing authority remains unverified.
Downtown 89 Chestnut venue identity; six generic nearby hotel options and summer residences, not UALE room commitments.
supportingSources.factVsInference: fact; mapping UALE wording to street address is inference

historicalEditions.lodgingEvidence: Archived official page documents hotel-based logistics, but the property name was not established. April 1 board meeting preceded the published April 2–5 conference.

Official notice moved the planned Chicago conference online on the same dates. The legacy Local Logistics (2022) page mixes a hoped-for Chicago 2022 event with January 2021 registration wording; it lists UIC Courtyard Dorms and a reserved Crowne Plaza Chicago West Loop block. These are legacy plans, not evidence of 2021 room consumption or a confirmed 2022 edition.

Official programme documents board meeting/registration June 12 and conference sessions June 13–16; refers to a conference hotel and hotel lobby without an established property name in the retrieved text. No room-block quantity located.

historicalEditions.localHost: UCLA Labor Center and Institute for Research on Labor and Employment
historicalEditions.lodgingEvidence: Official page: “UALE has reserved a block of rooms.” Reservations linked through Passkey or directly with the hotel using the conference code. Historical only; no block size or consumption located.

suggestedOrsFollowUps: Obtain organizer confirmation of exact venue address and the person responsible for accommodation sourcing.
Confirm contracted hotels/residences and whether a supplemental block is permitted; request actual room-demand and rate parameters before assigning sales eligibility.
Check any union-property requirement against the hotel’s actual status, and confirm hotel inventory, catering capability and travel practicality before a proposal.
remainingUncertainties: UALE does not print the venue street address; confirm that its named Conference Center is the university venue at 89 Chestnut Street.
2027 lodging mechanism, incumbent properties, contracted residence inventory, rates, exclusivity, booking deadline and willingness to accept an additional hotel remain unpublished.
Expected/confirmed attendance, out-of-town share, peak rooms, room nights and stay pattern remain unverified.
Named 2027 housing lead, purchasing authority and any PCO involvement remain unconfirmed; archived VP duties are not proof of individual contract control.
Budget, transit tolerance, union-hotel requirements and accessibility requirements are unknown.
The supplied hotel profile does not establish current catering/restaurant availability or event-date inventory; verify before quoting.
No post-2027 Toronto edition or fixed geographic rotation is established.
